scope: Read-only audit of saved execution records. No new model, engineering, prover, build, test, runtime or hardware measurement was performed. Manuscripts and historical evidence were not edited.

units.tokens: Measured input + output tokens; cached input is a subset, never added again. Unknown-use estimated budget debits are reported separately.
units.seconds: Saved floating-point clock values; digits retained for checking arithmetic, not a claim of physical-clock precision.

definitions.model_dispatch_seconds: Controller monotonic interval around admission dispatch, worker execution, and receipt persistence. Includes client/controller overhead; not provider-only inference time.
definitions.tool_seconds: Sum of saved engineering-check command intervals within the explicitly named phase. Does not imply all later diagnostics or rechecks are included.
definitions.trajectory_elapsed_seconds: Wall-clock elapsed time saved by the phase controller. A resumed controller may save only its local segment.
definitions.cross_phase_wall_span_seconds: Difference between specified wall-clock endpoints; includes approval/harness/other gaps between dependent phases.
definitions.historical_reservation_to_usage_seconds: Sum of each call reservation-to-usage-ledger interval. Excludes tools executed outside those intervals and is not end-to-end case time.
definitions.dispatch_start: Admission dispatch registration time, not a provider-side inference-start timestamp.
definitions.endpoints: Derived trajectory end=start+saved elapsed is identified as derived. Documentary completion-record creation can be later than execution completion.

host_resources.search_coverage: Structured keys in the deduplicated model-call receipts enumerated below;10 named top-level study-freeze/protocol records; final runtime/engineering receipts and selected phase progress/report tables. No global filesystem scan, current machine probe, or full provider-side diagnostic inventory.
host_resources.status: No per-case CPU time, peak RSS, GPU utilization, CPU model/count, physical memory, accelerator or historical host-resource snapshot was established in these inspected records. Saved wall/monotonic durations are not CPU-time measurements. This is bounded absence of evidence, not a claim no such log exists elsewhere. Current machine properties were deliberately not queried.

additional_bounded_text_search.scope: Seven finite saved experiment roots spanning the three cases; source/candidate/generated/target trees and model prompts/responses excluded; searched text/JSON/log files <=512KiB for explicit resource measurement labels. No host probes.
